I have the S24U, an excellent smartphone—up there with the best. The S25U is an iterative update that improves imperfections with a few design tweaks. It certainly would not persuade me to trade up. I did trade the S23U in for the S24U to get a flat display, as I hate curved ones, but nothing here adds value. Battery life on the S24U is two days for me, performance is overkill, the display is Grade A, it is smooth, and it has performed with very few issues over the year. The cameras are above average with pros and cons, but no perfect camera phone exists. This is very expensive for those not trading in, coming from much older devices, but it would likely be a fantastic long-term buy. But then again, there are cheaper, similarly excellent phones in Europe that I can say the same for, so if I were buying now, I would probably buy the Honor Magic 7 Pro at £350 less or the OP13 with a free watch for a similar saving.
